title: BombSweeper
summary: Clear every safe tile. The mines are listening.
description:
BombSweeper is a fast minesweeper for the SakutaOS desktop. Pick a difficulty, flag the tiles you don't trust, and chord open the rest. Personal bests stay on this machine, and a win lands in the notification shade.

The board is built for a trackpad or a finger: left click reveals, right click or a long press plants a flag, and the arcade HUD keeps the clock and the remaining mines in view.
whatsNew: Smoother board entrance and a tighter personal-best board.

reviews.name: Htet Lin
reviews.body: The chord reveal is the whole game. I stopped counting and started listening for the empty-tile cascade.

reviews.name: Maya Chen
reviews.body: Expert is cruel in the best way. Personal bests surviving a refresh is what made me keep it installed.

reviews.name: Jonah Abe
reviews.body: Looks like a toy, plays like a timer. I only wish the flag button were a little larger on my phone.

reviews.name: Soe Nandar
reviews.body: Long-press to flag actually works. Most browser minesweepers fumble that.

reviews.name: Priya Raman
reviews.body: Beginner is over before I settle in. Intermediate is the one I leave open.

reviews.name: Leo Park
reviews.body: The win screen is loud enough to feel like an arcade cabinet. Lost three evenings to it.
